definition: to crowd tightly together in a group
description: At a bus stop in heavy evening rain, about ten people in jackets and hoods squeeze tightly together under the small glass shelter roof: a woman holding a cake box, a man with a bicycle and a cyclist in a helmet. At the edge a laughing young man in a wet white T-shirt holds a paper bag over his head as water pours off the roof onto him, and the people huddle even closer. Red double-decker buses with their lights on come along the shining wet street under the streetlights.

en.question: What is the soaked man doing?

de.answer: Er schützt seinen Kopf mit einer Papiertüte.
de.question: Was macht der durchnässte Mann?

es.answer: Se está protegiendo la cabeza con una bolsa de papel.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre empapado?

fr.answer: Il se protège la tête avec un sac en papier.
